listing.descriptionMarkdown:
## About
Stream radio stations from around the world on Rokid Glasses. EK World Radio automatically resumes the last station you listened to when you reopen the app.

A Wi-Fi connection is required for streaming.

## Controls

- **Browse channels:** Touch the right temple of the glasses to switch stations.
- **Resume playback:** Your last station starts again when you reopen the app.
- **Network:** Keep Wi-Fi connected for uninterrupted listening.
